001: Hello, thank you for coming today. Please, have a seat.
Hello, thank you very much. I'm delighted to be here.
Could you start by briefly introducing yourself?
Of course. My name is Lucas, and I have five years of experience in digital marketing.
Very good. And why did you leave your last position?
I was looking for a new challenge with more responsibilities.
002: What would you say are your main professional qualities?
I would say that I'm organized and, above all, very meticulous in my work.
And what is your biggest weakness?
I tend to want to control everything, but I'm learning to delegate.
It's a good thing to be aware of that. How do you handle stress?
I exercise regularly and I prioritize my tasks effectively.
003: Tell me about a difficult situation you handled.
Last year, a major project fell behind schedule because of a supplier.
How did you solve that problem?
I found an alternative supplier and I renegotiated the deadlines.
Impressive. And what was the final result?
We delivered the project only three days late.
004: Why do you want to join our company?
I admire your reputation and your innovative projects in the industry.
What do you know about our company culture?
I know that you value autonomy and collaboration between teams.
That's correct. How do you see your role in this team?
I think I could bring my experience and a fresh perspective.
005: Where do you see yourself in five years?
I would like to move up to a senior project manager position.
And how do you plan to get there?
By continuously training myself and taking on new challenges.
That's an ambitious approach. Are you willing to travel often?
Yes, absolutely, I'm available for frequent travel.
006: What is your current salary, if you don't mind my asking?
I currently earn forty-five thousand euros a year.
And what are your salary expectations?
I'm hoping to get around fifty-two thousand euros a year.
That's a bit above our range, but it's negotiable.
I'm open to discussion, of course.
007: How do you react to criticism of your work?
I see it as an opportunity to grow and improve.
Can you give me a concrete example?
A former manager told me that my reports were too detailed.
And what did you do to change that?
I learned to summarize and to focus on what's essential.
008: Do you have any questions about the position?
Yes, I'd like to know more about the day-to-day responsibilities.
You'll be in charge of the digital strategy and campaign tracking.
Very good. And how big is the team I'd be joining?
A team of six people, very close-knit and dynamic.
Perfect, that sounds like a stimulating environment.
009: How do you stay informed about trends in your industry?
I read specialized blogs and I attend conferences regularly.
Do you take any particular training courses?
Yes, I just finished a certification in data analysis.
That's very relevant for this position. And what did you get out of it?
I gained valuable skills to optimize our future campaigns.
010: Do you have any other experience that could be useful to us?
I also worked abroad for two years, in London.
How did that experience enrich you professionally?
It taught me to adapt quickly and to work in English.
That's definitely an asset for our international company.
I'm convinced that it could be a real plus for your teams.
